Platform Overview

The ANSARK Platform

End-to-end AI governance — from tenant policy and runtime enforcement to audit evidence and regulatory control automation.

Runtime Governance

AI Governance Gateway

Place ANSARK between your application and LLM provider. Every request is authenticated, checked against tenant policy, redacted when needed, and validated again before it reaches the user.

API key / JWT tenant enforcement
PII redaction before model calls
Jailbreak and semantic risk gates
Schema and numeric post-response checks
Retry, circuit breaker, and request tracing
gateway_pipeline.log
# POST /v1/gateway/chat → auth: tenant scope verified → pii: PAN + Aadhaar redacted → jailbreak: clean → upstream: circuit closed → schema: valid JSON response allowed + audited
Policy System

Deterministic Policy Compiler

Turn natural-language security rules into canonical policy IR, then compile them into enforcement-ready formats. The LLM only extracts structure; validation, normalization, compilation, and verification are deterministic.

Canonical principal / action / resource mapping
Cedar, OPA/Rego, YAML, and XACML output
Schema validation before compilation
Confidence scoring and review metadata
Policy versioning and rollback support
policy_ir.json
{ "effect": "permit", "principal": "developers", "action": "read", "resource": "server_logs", "compiler_targets": [ "cedar", "opa", "yaml", "xacml" ], "routing": "approved" }
Governance Workflow

Confidence Routing

Policy and control changes should not silently move to production. ANSARK scores extraction and resolution quality, then routes changes to approved, review, enrichment, or rejected states.

Per-field extraction confidence
Resolution confidence vs catalog
Automatic approval for high-confidence
Human review queue for edge cases

Ready for policy compilation

Compliance Input Layer

Regulatory Control Automation

Regulatory documents become one source for governance policy. RBI/DPSS clauses can be extracted into structured controls, reviewed by humans, and connected to the same policy lifecycle as runtime AI controls.

PDF text extraction and section splitting
ControlIR with temporal and evidence fields
Catalog normalization for subject/action/resource
Review queue for low-confidence controls
Governance YAML output for audit evidence
control_extract.log
# RBI/DPSS rule → governance control → section: 26a → action: conduct_va → resource: critical_systems_dmz → temporal: every_6_months → routing: approved compiled to Governance YAML
